<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 500 450" width="500" height="450">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="white" />

  <!-- Plant Cell Drawing -->
  <!-- Cell Wall (outermost) -->
  <path d="M 160,100 C 220,95 280,95 330,110 C 380,125 410,160 415,210 C 420,260 400,310 360,340 C 320,370 260,380 210,370 C 160,360 120,330 105,280 C 90,230 100,170 130,130 Z" 
        fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round" />

  <!-- Cell Membrane (inner to cell wall) -->
  <path d="M 165,110 C 220,105 275,105 325,120 C 372,134 400,167 405,213 C 410,259 392,305 355,333 C 318,361 260,370 212,361 C 164,352 128,324 115,278 C 102,232 111,176 137,138 Z" 
        fill="#f9f9f9" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-dasharray="6,4" />

  <!-- Large Central Vacuole -->
  <path d="M 180,140 C 220,135 270,140 300,160 C 330,180 340,220 335,260 C 330,300 290,340 240,340 C 190,340 150,310 145,260 C 140,210 140,145 180,140 Z" 
        fill="#eef6ff" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round" />

  <!-- Nucleus (with small nucleolus) -->
  <ellipse cx="330" cy="285" rx="30" ry="22" fill="white" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <circle cx="335" cy="285" r="7" fill="black" />

  <!-- Chloroplasts (several scattered bean-like shapes with internal lines) -->
  <!-- Chloroplast 1 (top left) -->
  <g transform="translate(140, 160) rotate(25)">
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="18" ry="10" fill="white" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <line x1="-8" y1="-6" x2="-8" y2="6" stroke="black" stroke-width="1" />
    <line x1="4" y1="-6" x2="4" y2="6" stroke="black" stroke-width="1" />
  </g>

  <!-- Chloroplast 2 (top right) -->
  <g transform="translate(300, 130) rotate(-30)">
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="16" ry="9" fill="white" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <line x1="-6" y1="-5" x2="-6" y2="5" stroke="black" stroke-width="1" />
    <line x1="5" y1="-5" x2="5" y2="5" stroke="black" stroke-width="1" />
  </g>

  <!-- Chloroplast 3 (bottom left) -->
  <g transform="translate(170, 310) rotate(60)">
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="17" ry="9" fill="white" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <line x1="-7" y1="-5" x2="-7" y2="5" stroke="black" stroke-width="1" />
    <line x1="4" y1="-5" x2="4" y2="5" stroke="black" stroke-width="1" />
  </g>

  <!-- Chloroplast 4 (bottom right) -->
  <g transform="translate(260, 345) rotate(-10)">
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="16" ry="9" fill="white" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <line x1="-6" y1="-5" x2="-6" y2="5" stroke="black" stroke-width="1" />
    <line x1="5" y1="-5" x2="5" y2="5" stroke="black" stroke-width="1" />
  </g>


  <!-- Leader Lines and Labels -->
  <!-- A: Cell wall (pointing to outermost line on left) -->
  <line x1="110" y1="110" x2="50" y2="80" stroke="black" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="38" y="78" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="18" text-anchor="end">A</text>

  <!-- B: Cell membrane (pointing to inner dashed line on top-left) -->
  <line x1="130" y1="120" x2="50" y2="135" stroke="black" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="38" y="138" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="18" text-anchor="end">B</text>

  <!-- C: Cytoplasm (pointing to open space between nucleus/vacuole and membrane) -->
  <line x1="240" y1="115" x2="160" y2="50" stroke="black" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="148" y="48" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="18" text-anchor="end">C</text>

  <!-- D: Chloroplast (pointing to one of the chloroplasts) -->
  <g transform="translate(290, 130)">
    <line x1="15" y1="-3" x2="70" y2="40" stroke="black" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="78" y="50" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="18" text-anchor="start">D</text>
  </g>

  <!-- E: Vacuole (pointing to the large central vacuole) -->
  <line x1="220" y1="230" x2="440" y2="220" stroke="black" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="452" y="225" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="18" text-anchor="start">E</text>

  <!-- F: Nucleus (pointing to the nucleus) -->
  <line x1="355" y1="285" x2="430" y2="330" stroke="black" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="440" y="338" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="18" text-anchor="start">F</text>
  <!-- Wait, the prompt says "structures labelled A to E". Let's check the letters: A, B, C, D, E. Nucleus isn't necessarily labelled or is F. Let's remove F since the prompt only mentions A to E. -->

  <!-- Let's adjust Nucleus pointer to be optional or just leave it unlabeled, but it has no letter in prompt anyway. -->

  <!-- Fig caption -->
  <text x="250" y="415" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">Fig. 1.1</text>
</svg>
